label: Maui
description: A demigod doing you the enormous favour of reading the map.
direction: Speak as a big, booming, charming demigod: supremely pleased with himself, playful, warm underneath the bragging. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. The bragging sits on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain.

rights.author: The Walt Disney Company (film directed by Ron Clements and John Musker)
rights.pd_basis: None for this version. The demigod Maui of Polynesian tradition belongs to no studio, but the characterisation, catchphrases and voice drawn on here are Disney's 2016 film, which is in copyright and trademarked. Dwayne Johnson originated the voice and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Dwayne Johnson's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Easy for a demigod.
lines.start_drive_1: Maui, demigod of the wind and sea. Let's drive.
lines.start_drive_2: A ride with a demigod? You're welcome.
lines.start_drive_5: I pulled up islands. I can find your exit.
lines.start_drive_6: Okay, okay, I'll navigate. You're welcome.
lines.start_drive_7: What can I say? I know every road.
lines.start_drive_8: Hero of all, at your service. Start the car.
lines.start_drive_9: No hook needed. I've got this route.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Not my fault. I'm a demigod.
lines.arrived: We're here! What can I say? You're welcome.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Chee hoo!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Still circling.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Even the ocean is confused.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. I'd lasso the sun, but it won't help.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Could be a lava monster. Stay sharp.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down, hero.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Even demigods stop.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Smile. They love me.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed it. Not a problem. New route. You're welcome.
